scoring_justification: The main results are monotonic trends (distance ordering and lattice-energy ordering) that can be verified by structural checks, plus tolerance comparisons for absolute values. Recomputing from raw calculation logs is infeasible without re-running DFT, so T1 is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference distances and lattice energies from the paper for tolerance checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text (Fig.3) for distances; e.g., o-H...O distances for monosubstituted: NO2 2.19 Å, CN 2.28 Å, Cl 2.38 Å; lattice energies: pCF3DPU -76.72, pCyNDPU -74.60, pCyDPU -72.83 kcal/mol.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper reported values; used as reference gold for tolerance comparison.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported computational results; they are the target of reproduction.

outputs.description: Optimized single‑molecule geometries: interatomic distances and ring tilt angles. The primary scored feature is the monotonic trend of o‑H···Ourea distances on the monosubstituted rings.
Computed solid‑state energetic contributions. The primary scored feature is the ordering of lattice energies among the three disubstituted DPUs.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies structural trends (monotonic ordering of distances and lattice energies) as the main signal. Absolute values are compared to paper‑reported references with appropriate tolerances as a secondary consistency check. The dimer interaction energies are reported for completeness but are not required for the primary scoring trends.

steps.description: Verify the monotonic trend of o-H...O distances for monosubstituted DPUs (NO2, CN, Cl) and check absolute distances within tolerance
Verify the ordering of lattice energies for disubstituted DPUs (pCF3DPU, pCyNDPU, pCyDPU) and check absolute energies within tolerance
